property_summary: For all callers and slope inputs, the reference contract requires access control to call setSlopes (calls by unauthorized callers revert), whereas the mutant removes this check allowing any caller to successfully set slopes; the test fuzzes caller address and slope.kink to find a caller that is unauthorized in reference but succeeds in mutant.
change_summary: Change access control so setSlopes is callable without checking access by removing the checkAccess modifier invocation from the function signature (affects who can call and thus observable state after calls).
